piezas.titular: Three passes. Nobody asked to see them.

clips.escena: Medium close shot of a welder at a steel workbench in a small Puerto Rico fabrication shop, TIG welding a butt joint between two thick steel plates. Welding helmet DOWN, face not visible, worn leather jacket, leather TIG gloves. One gloved hand holds a real industrial water-cooled TIG torch with a black rubber torch body, a pink-white ceramic alumina cup and a short tungsten electrode, with its gas hose and power cable running back out of frame to the welding machine; the other feeds a thin silver filler rod into the joint. The arc is a small intense white point at the joint, no sparks.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. The torch travels very slowly and steadily along the joint while the filler rod dips in and out in a small, regular rhythm. The arc flickers naturally, faint smoke rises. Static camera with a very slow push-in. No sudden movements. Ambient hiss of the TIG arc.

clips.escena: Close-up of the same welding: two gloved hands, a real industrial water-cooled TIG torch with a black rubber torch body, a pink-white ceramic alumina cup and a short tungsten electrode, with its gas hose and power cable running back out of frame to the welding machine angled over a steel plate joint with a fresh shiny weld bead forming behind the cup, a thin filler rod entering the puddle. Small white arc, no sparks, background dark and out of focus.
clips.movimiento: Realistic macro footage continuing this exact photo. The torch moves a few centimeters slowly along the joint, the bead grows behind it, the filler rod dabs the puddle steadily. Camera static. No new objects. Ambient arc hiss.

clips.escena: Close-up of a finished multi-pass weld on a steel plate butt joint, still slightly warm, heat tint colors on the metal, resting on a steel bench. A gloved hand rests beside it. No torch in frame, no arc, no spark, no glow. Soft side light from a shop door.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. Very slow camera push-in along the weld. The gloved thumb slowly runs along the bead once. Nothing else moves. Quiet shop ambience.

piezas.copy:
Root. Fill. Cap.

Then someone reads one page of paper and decides whether you can weld.

piezas.titular: 6G no es un título. Es una posición.

clips.escena: A pipe welder in a small working fabrication shop in Puerto Rico, TIG welding a STRAIGHT carbon steel pipe (not an elbow, not a bend) fixed on a pipe stand and tilted at a 45-degree angle (6G test position). The butt joint is in the middle of the straight pipe where two straight sections meet, with a partially completed circumferential weld around it. Welding helmet DOWN, face not visible, worn leather jacket, leather TIG gloves. He holds a real industrial water-cooled TIG torch with a black rubber torch body, a pink-white ceramic alumina cup and a short tungsten electrode, with its gas hose and power cable running back out of frame to the welding machine and feeds a filler rod with the other hand. Small white arc, no sparks. Low three-quarter angle.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. The welder moves the torch very slowly around the pipe joint, the filler rod dips steadily, the arc flickers, faint smoke drifts. His body stays still. Camera static with a very slow push-in. No sudden movements. Ambient arc hiss.

clips.escena: Wider shot of the same 6G test: a STRAIGHT fixed steel pipe (not an elbow) on a stand tilted at 45 degrees, the welder kneeling and leaning to reach under the joint, helmet DOWN, face not visible, leather jacket and gloves, holding a real industrial water-cooled TIG torch with a black rubber torch body, a pink-white ceramic alumina cup and a short tungsten electrode, with its gas hose and power cable running back out of frame to the welding machine. The welding machine and its cables are visible on the floor behind him. Small white arc, no sparks.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. The welder keeps welding slowly under the joint with steady, small hand movements. Very slow orbit of the camera to the right. Nothing appears or disappears. Ambient shop sound and arc hiss.

clips.escena: Empty pipe test stand in a fabrication shop: a STRAIGHT carbon steel pipe (not an elbow) tilted at 45 degrees, with a completed circumferential butt weld in the middle where two straight sections meet. Clean, even weld ripples, slight heat tint. No people, no hands, no torch, no arc, no glow.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. The camera slowly orbits a little around the pipe joint to show the weld. Nothing else moves. Quiet shop ambience.
clips.sub:
No es un título.
Es una posición.

piezas.copy:
Tubo fijo a 45 grados. El que la ha corrido sabe por qué duele.

Y en un resumé se escribe igual que cualquier otra línea.

En Bears LinkUp la posición va en su propio espacio del perfil, donde la ve quien busca exactamente eso.
